text.en:
13th_ DECEMBER, 2014 No. S 65

MENTAL HEALTH ORDER, 2014 (S 25!2014) Notification of commencement In exercise of the power conferred by section 1(1) of the Mental Health Order, 2014, the Minister of Health, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints 1st. November, 2014 as the date on which that order shall commence. Dated this 30th. day of Zulkaedah, 1435 Hijriah corresponding to the 25th. day of September, 2014.

PEHIN ORANG KAYA JOHAN PAHLAWAN DATO SERI SETIA

AWANG HAJI ADANAN BIN BEGAWAN PEHIN SIRAJA KHATIB DATO SERI SETIA AWANG HAJI MOHD_ YUSOF, Minister of Health, Brunei Darussalam.
